scope: Desktop Node comparison of real Actor.refreshConditions and World.update. Rotating controls, five warmups and 25 timed samples. Setup/forced GC/receipt construction excluded from timing; loops, condition publication instrumentation, synthetic state changes, event queue draining and native work included. Stable/changing cases have 64 actors with explicitly supplied pools/modifiers; quiet world has 16 actors and 128 native updates. Combat runs a real Cleave kill, recency expiry and the native authored ward proc sweep with explicit target vitals and direct proc grant. This does not measure rendering, physical input, full encounters or FPS. Retained heap uses 1024 actors and three rotating forced-GC samples; allocation volume, peak RSS, total GC cost and device performance are not measured.
